verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's own product page describes in-product AI: an AI code reviewer that reviews all code changes and suggests fixes, plus AI-powered search, chat, code review and pipeline triage over the user's repositories and pipelines. That covers the core of getting AI insights and suggestions from your data inside the product. The evidence is only marketing-level copy, so depth and scope are unproven. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of what insights the chat/search/triage features produce, independent or hands-on corroboration of the AI reviewer and insights quality.
